svg.title: How the hourly tariff bills two stays
svg.desc: KA01 stays 09:00 to 11:30, which touches three started hours, so the car rate of 40 is billed three times: 120. BIKE1 stays 09:20 to 09:28, eight minutes, inside the ten-minute grace period, so it pays 0.
svg.text: every started hour is billed; 10 minutes of grace
car rate 40 an hour; motorcycle 20; truck 80
